text:
anna_ops: Heads up — ACME pushed our H100 allocation by ~6 weeks. This hits our Dedicated commit for EU-west next month. Need quick decision: accept later delivery, switch some orders to lease top-ups, or ask for an expedited split shipment. Any cost/ops tradeoffs?

mike_sourcing: Ugh. Vendor just messaged: container delay + customs backlog in FRA. I asked for split-air for 30 units max, they'll quote air+broker. Waiting on numbers.

linda_logistics: If we do split-air we need HS code change approval (fraud checks will raise). Also customs fees + duty recalc — could add ~€1.2k/unit. Can push documentation now if you want to pursue.

anna_ops: @linda_logistics start the HS approval flow. @mike_sourcing can you get expedited quote? Also, we need RMA/DOA plan in case some arrive DOA after air transits.

jay_rma: For partial air: request vendor to include pre-shipment photos, SN manifest, and DOA allowance on AWB. Our preferred flow: vendor provides temporary serial list, we stage 10 spare units in AMS depot as buffer. If DOA >3% on first 30, vendor covers return freight and crossdock fee. If DOA <3% we absorb depot handling.

mike_sourcing: Got initial air quote: +€95k for 30 units (air freight + broker). That's rough math ~€3.1k/unit. Vendor says 6-week land ETA or 8-day air ETA but with no guaranteed slots.

procurement-bot: Current committed vs need snapshot:
```
committed_total: 240
needed_for_dedicated_eu: 270
available_spare_pool: 8
```
Short by 30 for the Dedicated commit window.

anna_ops: Good to have the numbers. If we air 30 we'll cover the commit but spike costs. Is there a hybrid: lease 30 short-term GPUs from partner (30-day) until land arrival?

linda_logistics: Leasing short-term avoids customs reclass for import of new purchase, simpler handoffs, but you pay daily lease rates and possible integration friction. Also need network onboarding for 30 ephemeral cards (time ~2 days).

jay_rma: For lease path, confirm whether partner accepts vendor-origin SNs in spare manifest. We can map leased units into a separate pool to avoid commingling with owned inventory — simpler for RMAs.

mike_sourcing: I pinged two leasing partners, initial lease rate estimate ~€45/unit/day for H100 (min 30 days) or €28/day for H200s. Lease partner requires preauth and local depot handling fee ~€2k.

anna_ops: Quick decision call: we prefer minimal ops overhead. Option A: Air 30 units from vendor (pay +€95k + duties). Option B: Lease 30 until vendor land arrives (higher daily but predictable). Option C: Accept delayed commit and shift capacity (customer impact). Vote or objections? :raising_hand:

linda_logistics: Leaning lease. Less customs friction and we avoid splitting vendor shipment which complicates RMA and insurance.

jay_rma: Lease too — RMAs easier, vendor retains liability for purchased batch when it arrives. If we air-pull, insist on vendor covering DOA >=5% or prepay return labels. Add clause in email now.

mike_sourcing: I'll negotiate: ask vendor for either (1) split-air with vendor-paid returns >=5% DOA and waiving export broker fee, or (2) hold land shipment + priority slot. Also ask for discount on unit price for the delay.

procurement-bot: Draft email snippet to vendor (copy/paste ready):
```
Hi ACME team,
We urgently need 30x H100s for our EU-west Dedicated commit. Please provide:
- Split-air AWB quote (30 units) with vendor-covered return freight for DOA >=5%
- Pre-shipment SN manifest + photos
- Confirmation of HS code and duty estimate
- Discount on delayed land shipment or credit toward freight
Thanks,
Redwood Inference Procurement
```

anna_ops: Perfect. @mike_sourcing send that and cc Jay for RMA terms. I'll prep a temporary capacity plan (can degrade some non-critical jobs) if air/lease fall through.

mike_sourcing: Sent at 1739891360. Vendor replied (summarized): "Can do split-air for 30, vendor covers return freight up to 10 DOAs, vendor quotes €92k, needs HS confirmation." They requested our customs contact.

linda_logistics: I'll share KYC + HS docs. Also will open a customs pre-clearance ticket to reduce broker hold time.

jay_rma: Agree on buffer staging of 10 spares in AMS. I'll create the RMA playbook for this shipment: pre-authorized AWB return labels, expedited photo triage workflow, and a rapid replacement lane.

anna_ops: Great. We'll proceed with split-air if vendor signs the 10-spare buffer + DOA return terms and keeps €92k quotation. If vendor pushes higher, we'll lean lease. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
